segments.text: vfs_time_audit — samba vfs module to log slow VFS operations
This VFS module is part of the [[p0]] suite.
The [[p0]] VFS module logs system calls that take longer than the number of milliseconds defined by the variable [[p1]]. It will log the calls and the time spent in it.
It's kind of comparable with [[p0]] and is helpful to reveal performance problems with the underlying file and storage subsystems.
VFS calls that take longer than the defined number of milliseconds that should be logged. The default is 10000 (10s).
